content_sections.heading: About SJMU
content_sections.text: Sri Jagadhguru Murugarajendra University is a multidisciplinary State Private University in Karnataka. It was set up under the SJMU Act 2020 (Karnataka Act No. 21 of 2021). Its constituent institutions teach Medical, Dental, Pharmacy, Nursing, Allied Health Sciences, Physiotherapy and Engineering courses. The campus is at NH-48 Bypass, Chitradurga – 577502, Karnataka.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SJMU Physical Education Director Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the university website, www.sjmu.edu.in . Submit your application for the Physical Education Director post online. The notice accepts online applications only. Attend the walk-in interview on 5 November 2026. If you have questions, call 08194-200530 or email [email protected] . The Registrar's email address is [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many Physical Education Director posts does SJMU have?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts, both in the Department of Physical Education.

faq.question: Q2. What minimum marks do I need in my M.P.Ed.?
faq.answer: You need at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in your M.P.Ed. or equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 November 2026, eight days after the notice date of 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can I send my application by post?
faq.answer: No. The notice accepts applications online only, through www.sjmu.edu.in.

faq.question: Q5. Is a higher salary possible for experienced candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, it may be. The university may offer a higher starting pay to exceptionally meritorious candidates and may give extra incentives for outstanding achievements or skills.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the selected candidates work?
faq.answer: They will work in the constituent institutions of SJMU. These include medical, dental, pharmacy, nursing, allied health sciences, physiotherapy and engineering colleges, based at the Chitradurga campus on NH-48 Bypass.

faq.question: Q7. Whom can I contact about this recruitment?
faq.answer: You can call the university on 08194-200530 or email [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the notification number?
faq.answer: The notification number is SJMU/EST/RECT/2026-27/001. It was issued by the Registrar of Sri Jagadhguru Murugarajendra University, Chitradurga.
